status: PROVISIONAL — kernel/host measurement; not an assurance-track witness
authorisation: XIX.H1: one re-run of x86/add_p25519 under tools/cap.sh 24G

invocations.command: TEKMERION_ALG_CLOSE=x86.bignum_add_p25519.BIGNUM_ADD_P25519_CORRECT tools/cap.sh --timeout 3600 24G -- bash .bench/ix84/run_task_24g.sh x86 curve25519 add p25519 .bench/ix84/h1
invocations.note: x86.bignum_add_p25519 is deliberately not in ALGEBRAIC_CLOSE_TASKS, so the gate was ignored and this run exercised the SAT route, not H1's mechanism. It never approached the cap. It is disclosed for completeness and is not counted as the authorised test.

invocations.command: TEKMERION_ALG_CLOSE=x86.bignum_add_p25519.BIGNUM_ADD_P25519_CORRECT tools/cap.sh --timeout 3600 24G -- bash .bench/ix84/run_task_24g.sh x86 curve25519 add p25519 .bench/ix84/h1agg .bench/ix83/xadd1/x86_add_p25519.answer
invocations.failure: Fatal error: allocation failure during minor GC

memory_attribution.grows_at: the second bridge:algebra-arith close (the correction-plus-mask branch's INT_ARITH)
memory_attribution.evidence: the last marker written before the allocation failure is ORACLE aggregate-carriers=2 [&(bitval carry_s16),&(bitval carry_s8)]; the same wall was recorded at 12 G in ix83 §4.1
memory_attribution.cap_doubling: 12.31 GB at the 12 G cap (ix83) -> 24.89 GB at the 24 G cap; the peak roughly doubles with the cap and the theorem still does not close

diagnosis: The x86 add's correction is a full-width word_sub (word_add M N) p guarded by bit 63; the second (correction-plus-mask) branch's INT_ARITH builds a linear system whose internal representation grows past any practical address-space cap, so the mechanism does not scale on x86 as written.
decision: Do not raise the cap further and do not weaken the close. x86.bignum_add_p25519 remains outside ALGEBRAIC_CLOSE_TASKS. The published ARM totals are unaffected.
